init.title: Options
init.description:
**Update API & polling settings**: the request limit and update interval are changed.

**Update selected entities**: update the list of entities added to Home Assistant.

**Rediscover available entities and update selected entities**: refreshes the entity list and then lets you adjust your selection.

**Migrate to the name-based scheme (v2)**: one-time migration of an existing installation from IP-based entity ids (`sensor.eta_[ip]_…`) to name-based ones (`sensor.[name]_…`). This action only appears on installations still using the IP-based scheme.

rename_entities.title: Migrate to the name-based scheme
rename_entities.description:
This migrates all entity ids of this installation from `sensor.eta_[ip]_…` to `sensor.[name]_…`.

ℹ️ **The history is preserved.**

parallel_requests.title: API & polling settings
parallel_requests.description: Set how many ETA API requests may run at the same time and how often sensor values are fetched. Lower parallel-request values are more stable; a shorter update interval gives more responsive data but increases load on the ETA unit.

legacy_scheme_migration.title: Optional: migrate to the name-based scheme (v2)
legacy_scheme_migration.description:
This installation still uses the IP-based entity scheme (`{old_prefix}…`). It keeps working unchanged – you don't have to do anything.

If you want, you can migrate to the name-based scheme under Settings → Devices & Services → ETA → Configure. Only the prefix `{old_prefix}` is replaced with `[name]_`, the rest of the entity id stays the same – a search & replace in your dashboards is enough.

Note: the entity ids change, so automations, scripts and dashboards have to be updated manually afterwards. The history is preserved.
